strategyPoints: Tire management is going to be crucial on this Short Circuit. The abrasive surface here at Speedland can really chew through the rubber.
With such a short lap, fuel consumption isn't a major concern, but it's still something teams need to monitor closely.
The pit window is relatively short on this 0.8km layout. A quick stop is essential to avoid losing track position.
Overtaking can be tricky here, so getting a good start and maintaining track position will be key.
The kart setup will be a delicate balance between straight-line speed and cornering grip.
With so many tight corners, mechanical grip is going to be more important than outright power.
A well-timed slipstream can make all the difference on the straights. Drivers will be looking to maximize this advantage.
The short lap length means traffic will be a constant issue. Navigating the lapped karts will be a real challenge.
